text:
A whippet took best in show at the Eddlestone Dog Trials on Saturday, the final day of the event, according to the Eddlestone Kennel Association's official results bulletin.

The bulletin was read aloud at the closing ceremony in the Harrowgate Pavilion on 14 September 2024. It recorded that 212 dogs competed across 31 breeds in the best in show round.

Marguerite Oyelaran-Finch, the association's Chief Steward and Head Judge, is named in the bulletin as the official responsible for the final result. The document lists the whippet as the winning breed and does not record any dispute over the outcome.

The association said the bulletin is its definitive account of the trials. Full placings for the other breeds in the round are set out in the same document.
